title: Hoagland and Flynn hold joint conferences on the Mars ruins

tellings.quote: And in fact, Richard Hogland would did a series of conferences with David Flynn

plain: Between about 1990 and 2003, Richard Hoagland, a writer who claims there are ruins of structures on Mars, is said to have held a series of conferences with another writer, David Flynn, about those supposed ruins. The researcher Tim Alberino mentions this to Michels without naming a source, in a conversation that also brings up the biblical scholar Michael Heiser. He tells it to show that people pushing the Mars-ruins idea were working together.
